newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tabcorp sees 10 pct revenue growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tabcorp sees 10 pct revenue growth.

text.p: Betting agency and gaming group Tabcorp Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it expected to achieve revenue growth of 10 percent in the year to June 30, 1998.

Asked by a reporter how the company would perform in the 1997/98 financial year to June 30, Tabcorp managing director Ross Wilson said: "We are still seeing growth rates in the vicinity of 10 percent (in the Victorian gambling industry).
"We will go with the market," he said.
Wilson said the company had not seen any downturn in its revenue since the opening of the permanent Crown casino complex in Melbourne.
Tabcorp posted a net profit of A$87.17 million in the 1995/96 financial year on revenue of A$733.66 million.
Tabcorp shares were three cents lower at A46.50 at 3.10 p.m. (0510 GMT) on Wednesday.
